name: Haystack
identity_check: Confirmed as Haystack (haystack.vc), the early-stage VC firm Semil Shah founded in 2013, also written Haystack Ventures / Haystack VC; legal entity Haystack Management Company, LLC (site footer). SEC Form Ds for Haystack Ventures IV-VIII, L.P. and HMC Needles I-III, L.P. all name Semil Shah as managing director/manager of the GP. Not Haystack Robotics (Portland UV-disinfection robot startup), not deepset's Haystack LLM framework, not Haystack Partners I LP (NY), Haystack Investment Fund LP (IL) or the 'Haystack .. Fund I, a series of Opportunity Master Funds' entities (WA/UT) in EDGAR, not Haystacks.AI, Haystack Oncology or MIT Haystack Observatory.

thesis_text.value: Pre-seed and seed fund that backs outlier founders at the very start, often before the idea is clear, choosing people over predefined themes. Writes $1-3M initial checks in a company's first or second raise, can lead or co-lead, takes no board seats, and helps with later financings. Portfolio spans consumer, software, AI, dev tools, hardware/frontier and healthcare.
thesis_text.snippet: We look for people early, oftentimes before there is a clear idea. We get to know them as individuals.

open_items: Funds I-III: no size or date found; EDGAR has no Haystack Ventures I-III entities. Crunchbase News (2019) says Shah raised '$40 million for his first fund', which no other source confirms.
Fund IV and Fund VI: only initial Form Ds (targets $25M and $50M, $0 sold); final sizes and close dates are not published.
Fund V and VII close_date are the dates of the Form D filings that report the offering fully sold, not exact final-close dates. Fund VII's first sale was 2023-05-19 and it was announced 2023-09-10.

Needles I and II: sizes are the amounts sold in Form D/As filed 2025-01-13 ($23.98M and $16.15M against $25M offerings); final sizes and close dates are unknown. Needles II's original 2023 Form D shows a $125M offering, later amended to $25M.
The firm has no company LinkedIn page linked from haystack.vc or semilshah.com, so none was recorded.
No application form, pitch email or apply URL on haystack.vc or semilshah.com. Cold inbound is inferred from the open invitation in the April 2026 fund post.
Nothing found on investing in Indian founders or on requiring a US entity.
Tracxn lists a 'Sanjay Rama' as Principal; no firm page confirms this.
Aashay Sanghvi's LinkedIn is not linked from the firm's current team page; only his X profile is linked from semilshah.com.
The haystack.vc portfolio page renders only the 'Consumer & Commerce' tab statically; the Hardware & Frontier and other sector tabs could not be read.

Notable hardware and defense portfolio companies (Hadrian, Saronic, Applied Intuition, Astranis, nTop, Saildrone, Elroy Air): the round announcements found do not name Haystack, so they are skipped. The Exa Series B, Suno Series C and Nominal Series B-2 ($80M, March 2026) pages also do not name Haystack.
Type Five seed amount not found. Websites and founding years not stated on fetched pages for Polyphron, alphaXiv and ConductorAI; HQ not stated for Synthefy or alphaXiv.
Tracxn hints at more 2026 Haystack deals (RASA World Series A Oct 2026, Trebellar Series A Sept 2026), but no announcement naming Haystack was found.
